header.title: Attendance
header.subtitle: Auto, QR, or manual — all three work together.

autoToggle.label: Auto attendance (21:00)
autoToggle.hintOn: On: attendance is written daily at 21:00 for active workers. Remove no-shows with “Didn’t come”.
autoToggle.hintOff: Off: you take attendance with QR or manual timesheet.

qrHint: The code refreshes after each scan.
checkInsRemoveHint: Remove no-shows with “Remove”; no wage is written for them.
emptyCheckInsHint: No scans yet. Personnel should scan from the attendance page.
checkInPlanHint: These values are used when you finish attendance.
completedRemoveHint: Tap “Didn’t come” for no-shows — wage is deleted and the calendar shows absent.
dayLockedHint: This day is locked. A second QR session cannot be opened (duplicate pay guard). To fix: use “Didn’t come” or overwrite via manual timesheet.
markDidNotWorkTitle: Delete wage, mark did not work
noSessionOpenHint: Start attendance; people are added as they scan.
noSessionClosedHint: Attendance window is closed. Try again after work end time.
